title: The circle with your shadow carries it
assumes: The travel is B2's circle right three quarters with your shadow and the turn alone after it: you let go of the circle standing somewhere new, and the shoulder round that follows is danced from there.
quotes: B2  (6) Circle right 3/4 [with shadow]; turn alone  (10) N2 neighbor right shoulder round 1 & 1/2; face N3
notes: The relations after the clause are left exactly as the card writes them — the shoulder round still says N2 — so what the page shows is what the card's own words mean once the seating has moved a call earlier. **Measured** at six couples: `closure 86.1626 · progressed 104.9952 · reach 72.4292 short · collision 0.000`, and at **two and three couples it does not plan at all** — a waiting couple's `wait-out` overlaps the `walk-to-station` before it, which the lab now reports rather than throwing. The worst of the three readings on every number.
